# Micah 4 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 4:1 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-it-shall-be in-the-latter-[part]-of the-days, the-mountain-of the-house-of YHWH will-be-established at-the-head-of the-mountains, and-it-will-be-lifted-up above-the-hills, and-peoples will-stream to-it. |
| LOGOS | It shall come to pass in the latter days that the mountain of the house of the LORD shall be established as the highest of the mountains, and it shall be lifted up above the hills; and peoples shall flow to it, |
| PNEUMA | In the last days, the mountain where the LORD's Temple stands will become the most important mountain of all. It will be raised above the other hills, and people from all over the world will stream there to worship. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 4:4 (overlap: 4%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-they-will-sit, each under his-vine and-under his-fig-tree, and-none will-make-[them]-afraid, for the-mouth-of YHWH-of hosts has-spoken. |
| LOGOS | But they shall sit every man under his vine and under his fig tree, and no one shall make them afraid, for the mouth of the LORD of hosts has spoken. |
| PNEUMA | Everyone will sit peacefully under their own grapevine and fig tree, and no one will make them afraid. The LORD of Armies has spoken — and it will happen! |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 4:5 (overlap: 6%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | For all the-peoples walk, each in-the-name-of his-god, but-we will-walk in-the-name-of YHWH our-God forever and-ever. |
| LOGOS | For all the peoples walk each in the name of its god, but we will walk in the name of the LORD our God forever and ever. |
| PNEUMA | Though the nations around us follow their own gods, we will follow the LORD our God forever and ever. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 4:2 (overlap: 9%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-many nations will-go and-say, "Come, let-us-go-up to-the-mountain-of YHWH and-to-the-house-of the-God-of Jacob, and-He-will-teach-us from-His-ways and-we-will-walk in-His-paths." For from-Zion will-go-forth instruction, and-the-word-of YHWH from-Jerusalem. |
| LOGOS | And many nations shall come, and say: "Come, let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob, that He may teach us His ways and that we may walk in His paths." For out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem. |
| PNEUMA | People from many nations will come and say, "Come, let's go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the Temple of the God of Israel. He will teach us how to live, and we will follow His path." For the LORD's teaching will go out from Zion; His word will go out from Jerusalem. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 4:6 (overlap: 10%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "In-that day," declares YHWH, "I-will-assemble the-lame and-gather the-outcast and-those I-have-afflicted, and-I-will-make the-lame a-remnant and-the-far-removed a-strong nation; and-YHWH will-reign over-them in-Mount Zion from-now and-forever." |
| LOGOS | "In that day," declares the LORD, "I will assemble the lame and gather those who have been driven away, and those I have afflicted. I will make the lame into a remnant and the far-removed into a strong nation, and the LORD will reign over them in Mount Zion from now and forevermore." |
| PNEUMA | "On that day," says the LORD, "I will gather My people who have been crippled, scattered, and broken. I will transform the weak remnant into a strong nation, and I, the LORD, will rule from Mount Zion forever." |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.
